skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop advanced English language proficiency, including vocabulary, grammar, and complex expressions at the pre-C1 level, suitable for academic and social contexts.
Enhance the ability to understand and interpret complex and abstract topics in English, using advanced listening strategies.
Improve the ability to articulate arguments, engage in debates, and present ideas effectively in academic settings.
Develop critical thinking and analytical skills to evaluate and synthesize information from various sources.
Enhance teamwork and collaborative skills, including planning, managing resources, and evaluating group activities.
Foster independent learning skills, including planning, managing resources, and evaluating personal progress.
Improve academic communication skills, including appropriate behavior and attitudes in academic environments.
